bibl.title: Quint. 9, 2, 85-86 e P.Hamb. II 134, fra tecnica declamatoria e Satzrhythmus.
bibl.seg: Antonio Stramaglia, Quint. 9, 2, 85-86 e P.Hamb. II 134, fra tecnica declamatoria e Satzrhythmus.
bibl.note: P. Hamb. II, 134 (= MP3 2811; LDAB 4305) yields the remains of a declamation on a theme otherwise attested only by Quintilian (9, 2, 85-86). The declamation itself is to be dated to the beginning of the 4th century AD, and represents one of the earliest known instances of accentual Satzrhythmus in Greek prose.
